notes.title: Update v0.07.09 - Performance Options
notes.notes:
[p]Here's a small update, mainly to help with performance.

Changes:[/p][list][*][p]Vsync is now enabled by default (I totally thought it was already 🙃). This will help prevent excessive GPU usage. There is a setting to turn it off now too though.[/p][/*][*][p]Added options to decrease or fully remove the production visual (flying weapons). This should help performance even more if needed.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to make the production visual "mixed" instead of each weapon being on its own line. No performance gains here, you can just pick which one you like more[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470032/1c317220bb86e9a7ff509fe1591fe9cea2041cef.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Thanks for a great Next Fest!!
notes.notes: [p]Quick update just to say thanks to everyone for making Next Fest incredible!! We're super grateful for everyone who played the demo, wishlisted the game, gave feedback, reported bugs, helped us playtest, told your friends about it, joined the discord, or just generally talked about the game :)[/p][p][/p][p]Next Fest was one of our best weeks yet for the demo. We had: [/p][list][*][p]7,200 people play the demo[/p][/*][*][p]1,600 players beat the demo[/p][/*][*][p]4,000 people wishlist the game[/p][/*][*][p]400 people join the discord[/p][/*][/list][p]Those are crazy numbers, thanks for helping make that happen.[/p][p][/p][p]In case you didn’t see it in the demo, we’re running a name-an-upgrade-after-you Sweepstakes. To enter, beat the demo (there’s an “end of demo” research you’ll eventually discover), take a screenshot of the ending screen, and submit it to the “Sweepstakes” channel in our discord. We’re going to do the drawing this Friday, to give everyone a little more time to beat the demo if you haven’t already. And! We’ve decided to pick 3 winners, instead of just 1, since we’ve had so many people submit screenshots already![/p][p]Here’s a link to the discord if you aren’t in there already:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/unp9BR69cA"]https://discord.gg/unp9BR69cA[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: v0.04.3 Bugfix
notes.notes:
Another small update for y'all

1 new feature: the Progressive Press sticks around once you've unlocked automated presses, so you can still click as much as you'd like even with automated bullet production.

Bugs fixed:
[list]
[*] A bug that didn't allow some players to launch the game (or would crash shortly after launch) has been fixed, and old save files should work again
[*] You can no longer hold down a production button, click on another button, and have that production button still held down
[*] Grenades sometimes wouldn't let you press the explosive button, but that is now fixed
[/list]

notes.title: v0.04.2 Bugfix
notes.notes:
Massive shout out to Real Civil Engineer and others for making videos about this game and driving a ton of new players to try it out!! And big thanks to everyone who has played the demo, shared their feedback, and reported bugs! I really appreciate all of you.

Small bugfix update to address some issues found by newer players:
[list]
[*] Production progress bars have a set animation once they reach a certain speed, to hopefully stop burn-in occurring on some players screens
[*] Added a new audio slider to control the production sound effects (bullet, grenade, and gun clinks mainly) separate from the other sound effects
[*] Clarified you can click-and-hold the Single Stage Press and other upgrades
[*] Fixed saving and loading profit and expense rates
[/list]

Known issues:
[list]
[*] The game rarely crashes and then won't let the player relaunch it. This can typically be resolved by deleting the save files with the following process:
[*] Search %appdata% using the Search button on your taskbar. Then go to Godot -> app_userdata -> MilitaryIncrementalComplex. Then delete the one or two (there might be a backup) save_game_byte_array files there and try running the game again
[/list]
